title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!

title_en: In Don Bosko, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation and layout!
description_en: In Don Bosco, at the Al-Mak complex, 1+1 Apartment for sale, with Perfect Location and Orientation!!! The apartment is located on the sixth residential floor of a new building, with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​56 m2 and a net area of ​​51 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area and exit to the balcony, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. Orientation from the East makes it light in the morning. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting from the multi-layer hydraulic system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, double-glazed windows, parquet, patina, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
